text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraqi Foreign Minister Mohammed Saeed al-Sahaf agrees with his Iranian counterpart in Rabat to solve the problem of prisoners from the 1980-88 war.
- Russian Fuel and Energy Minister Pyotr Rodionov says his country has good chance in Iraq's oil-for-food deal with the United Nations.
- Iraqi Deputy Prime Mininster Tareq Aziz and Iraq's U.N. envoy Nazar Hamdoun attack U.S. Secretary of State Madeleine Albright for her remarks on Iraq.
- Some 249 trucks loaded with foodstuffs bought under the oil-for-food deal have so far arrived in Iraq.
(The above were also carried by AL-IRAQ)
- Jordanian Minister of Industry and Trade Hani al-Mulqi meets delegation of the Iraqi chambers of commerce federation.
